ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator: student-to-faculty ratio, fall 2024 admissions summary

stats.notes: CDS C1 fall 2025 first-year class: 20,881 applied, 19,864 admitted (95%), 2,705 enrolled (full-time plus part-time). Residency split as printed: international 173 applicants and 162 admitted (about 94%); 40 applicants (21 admitted) have unknown residency. The C11 GPA column for all enrolled students sums to 100.32% as printed. CSU campuses are test-blind; only 2.3% (SAT, 64 students) and 0.4% (ACT, 13 students) of enrollees had scores, so the SAT/ACT percentiles in C9 are omitted. intl_undergrads is the CDS B2 count of degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates (148); undergrad_enrollment is the CDS B total of all undergraduates (15,770). College Navigator (fall 2024) shows 19,721 applicants and 95% admitted.
